method: Compiled by reading the repository, not by reading its documents. A capability is IMPLEMENTED only if code executes it; CERTIFIED only if a regenerable artifact and a reproducible runner exist and were executed; PARTIALLY CERTIFIED where the artifact exists but the audit of 2026-08-11 found the gate proves less than claimed.

classification_scale.CERTIFIED: regenerable artifact plus reproducible runner, executed and PASS, gate proves what it claims
classification_scale.PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED: artifact exists and passes, but a recorded finding shows the gate proves less than documented
classification_scale.SPECIFIED: a resident specification exists; no implementation
classification_scale.PLANNED: named in a decision or roadmap; no specification
classification_scale.ABSENT: does not exist in any form

counts_note: Counts are deliberately omitted. A tally invites the impression that certified capabilities are comparable units, which they are not: D2 and the Tier-0 kernel carry very different weight.
